name: phantom-trading-platform
description: P.H.A.N.T.O.M — merged app with Paytm Money live trading

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix P.H.A.N.T.O.M-backend && npm install --prefix P.H.A.N.T.O.M-frontend
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && cross-env SERVE_FRONTEND=true USE_MEMORY_DB=true NODE_ENV=production npm start --prefix P.H.A.N.T.O.M-backend
scripts.dev:backend: cross-env USE_MEMORY_DB=true npm run dev --prefix P.H.A.N.T.O.M-backend
